what_it_is.prose: Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) operates its defence business through L&T Precision Engineering & Systems (L&T PES) and L&T Heavy Engineering. The company is listed on BSE (500510) and NSE (LT), headquartered at L&T House in Mumbai. L&T's defence-specific order book is approximately ₹20,000 crore (indicative, per LinkedIn sources); the L&T group's total order book was reported at ~₹2,21,113 crore in FY26 by Fortune India. L&T's flagship defence programme is the K9 Vajra-T 155mm/52-calibre tracked self-propelled howitzer, co-developed with Hanwha Aerospace of South Korea. The first batch of 100 K9 Vajra-T was delivered ahead of schedule under a ₹4,500 crore 2017 contract; a repeat order for 100 more was signed on 23 December 2024 for ₹7,629 crore. As of April 2026, the K9 Vajra-T programme has achieved 82%+ indigenous content at the work-package level. L&T is the hull fabricator for the Arihant-class SSBN nuclear submarines (S2, S3, S4, S4*) at the Ship Building Centre (SBC) Visakhapatnam. L&T is leading India's Project-76 indigenous diesel-electric submarine design effort, with a target design completion by 2027. L&T is also a bidder for Project-75I (in partnership with Navantia of Spain and ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems of Germany). Other programmes include Pinaka MBRL canister and launcher, BrahMos canister and launcher, Astra launcher, and the L&T PES Counter-Drone System (Atlas slug cus-057).

deployments_procurement.summary: L&T's defence commitments are anchored by the K9 Vajra-T programme (₹4,500 cr 2017 + ₹7,629 cr Dec 2024 = ~₹12,129 crore aggregate). The first 100 K9 Vajra-T were delivered ahead of schedule; the repeat order for 100 more was signed 23 December 2024. The K9 achieved 82%+ indigenous content by April 2026. L&T is the hull fabricator for the Arihant-class SSBN programme at SBC Visakhapatnam (S2 INS Arihant and S3 INS Arighat in service; S4 in trials 2026; S4* under construction). L&T is bidding for Project-75I with Navantia (Spain) and ThyssenKrupp (Germany).

faq.question: What is L&T's role in the K9 Vajra-T programme?
faq.answer: Larsen & Toubro (L&T) is the prime contractor for the K9 Vajra-T 155mm/52-calibre tracked self-propelled howitzer, co-developed with Hanwha Aerospace of South Korea. The first batch of 100 K9 Vajra-T was delivered ahead of schedule under a ₹4,500 crore 2017 contract; a repeat order for 100 more was signed on 23 December 2024 for ₹7,629 crore. As of April 2026, the K9 Vajra-T programme has achieved 82%+ indigenous content at the work-package level. Manufacturing is at the Armoured Systems Complex in Hazira, Gujarat — India's first private defence ASC.

faq.question: What is L&T's role in India's nuclear submarine programme?
faq.answer: L&T is the hull fabricator for the Arihant-class SSBN nuclear submarines (S2 INS Arihant, S3 INS Arighat, S4 in trials 2026, S4* under construction) at the Ship Building Centre (SBC) Visakhapatnam. L&T also leads India's Project-76 indigenous diesel-electric submarine design effort, with a target design completion by 2027. For Project-75(I), L&T is bidding in partnership with Navantia (Spain) against MDL+ThyssenKrupp (Germany).

faq.question: Why is L&T's defence revenue not separately disclosed?
faq.answer: L&T is a diversified conglomerate listed on BSE (500510) and NSE (LT), but its defence business operates through subsidiaries L&T Precision Engineering & Systems (L&T PES) and L&T Heavy Engineering, with revenue embedded in the consolidated 'Projects' and 'Hi-Tech Manufacturing' segments. Indicative LinkedIn sources cite a defence-specific order book of approximately ₹20,000 crore; the L&T group's total order book was reported at approximately ₹2,21,113 crore in FY26. Atlas should mark defence-specific revenue as 'not separately disclosed'.
